text:
jo: FYI hitting firstcall failure in our CI (GitLab) with the docker quickstart. local dev works. UI shows \"Tenant not authorized\" and no guidance.

harpreet: can you paste the gateway response?

jo: body:
```json
{\"error\":\"Tenant not authorized\",\"code\":\"tenant_blocked\"}
```

sam: common CI gotcha is env key mismatch. are you passing REDWOOD_ORG or REDWOOD_WORKSPACE? our quickstart examples use REDWOOD_ORG but some infra templates use REDWOOD_WORKSPACE which the SDK ignores.

jo: omg that's it — our pipeline sets REDWOOD_WORKSPACE from other tooling. container ended up with no org header. once i exported REDWOOD_ORG it worked.

infra-lee: ugh. two DX issues: 1) confusing env var names across examples 2) error message is non-actionable.

devex: propose: - quickstart: add a tiny preflight that prints effective env keys and warns if neither REDWOOD_ORG nor X-Redwood-Org present (exit non-zero in CI so pipelines fail fast) - docs: standardize on REDWOOD_ORG in all samples and note common aliases (REDWOOD_WORKSPACE) - SDK: if tenant_blocked and no org header, append a short hint string: \"Hint: set REDWOOD_ORG or X-Redwood-Org (CI pipelines might set REDWOOD_WORKSPACE). See https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<id>/billing\"

harpreet: +1. for CI it's important preflight fails the job rather than hanging with UI spinner. we should ship the preflight as a tiny shell script included in the image entrypoint.

sam: i'll own the SDK message tweak and add a unit test simulating missing header. keep it a human hint appended to message to avoid API schema churn.

infra-lee: i'll update quickstart CI templates and change examples in the infra repo to use REDWOOD_ORG explicitly. i'll add preflight.sh and make entrypoint call it. sample preflight snippet:
```bash
if [ -z \"$REDWOOD_ORG\" ]; then
  echo \"ERROR: REDWOOD_ORG not set. CI pipelines sometimes set REDWOOD_WORKSPACE — copy it to REDWOOD_ORG or set REDWOOD_ORG directly. See https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces for billing settings.\"
  exit 1
fi
```

billing-bot: Notice: workspace wz-ci-22 requires billing contact. Admins visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/wz-ci-22/billing to add payment/contact info.

jo: thanks everyone — copying the fix into our pipeline now. preflight would have saved an hour.

devex: filing tasks: ci-quickstart-preflight, sdk-tenant-block-hint, docs-standardize-redwood-org. assigning sam + infra-lee. will add a short note to welcome email: \"If firstcall fails in CI, check REDWOOD_ORG and workspace billing.\"

sam: PR incoming for SDK change and test.

infra-lee: PR for quickstart preflight + CI templates incoming.

jo: confirmed pipeline green after setting REDWOOD_ORG. closing loop. :rocket:
